records.key_findings: CoinDesk confirms that Binance14, an Ethereum hot wallet, was included in Binance's October 1 PoR and held 89,475 ETH plus 1.26B USDT among 37 assets. CoinDesk estimates the 204,500 ETH theft could reduce ETH reserve coverage from 100% to about 94% if not replenished. This does not establish PoR membership for the five separate XRPL source wallets. Historical Whale Alert transfers and Bithomp activation labels support a Binance-attributed XRPL operational cluster, but the official October 1 downloadable address file remains unavailable through static extraction.
records.next_action: Retrieve the official October 1 Binance all-address PoR file and exact-match the five XRPL wallets; if not accessible, preserve the explicit unknown and do not estimate XRP reserve coverage.
